title: Automated Cardiac Diagnosis Challenge (ACDC)

source_archive.note: Archive retained after extraction so the filing can be reproduced. It is redundant with data/raw/acdc and may be deleted; re-obtaining it requires provider registration, so it was not deleted automatically.

labels.note: One expert delineation per annotated frame; no repeat observers.

consequences_for_this_project: Derived artefacts carry ShareAlike, so any released mesh, contour or fitted template derived from ACDC inherits CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and cannot be released under this repository's MIT terms.
Non-commercial only, so ACDC-derived results cannot support a commercial claim or a commercially licensed release.
No redistribution, so the archive and extracted volumes stay untracked; only checksums and this record are committed.
